passage.text: Today was the first day of my first Model United Nations conference!
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ wʌz ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈdeɪ əv maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈmɑːdəl juˈnaɪtɪd ˈneɪʃənz ˈkɑːnfərəns!

passage.text: I was the representative of Thailand, so I sat behind a small Thai flag.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ðə ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntətɪv əv ˈtaɪlænd, soʊ aɪ ˈsæt bɪˈhaɪnd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈtaɪ ˈflæɡ.

passage.text: There were students from twenty countries, and everyone looked so confident.
passage.reading: ðɛr wɜːr ˈstuːdənts frəm ˈtwɛnti ˈkʌntriz, ənd ˈɛvriwʌn ˈlʊkt soʊ ˈkɑːnfɪdənt.

passage.text: I was so nervous that I couldn't eat lunch.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz soʊ ˈnɜːrvəs ðæt aɪ ˈkʊdənt ˈiːt ˈlʌntʃ.

passage.text: This morning, I gave my first speech about air pollution.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪ ˈɡeɪv maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈspiːtʃ əˈbaʊt ˈɛr pəˈluːʃən.

passage.text: My hands were shaking, but I didn't forget a single word.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈhændz wɜːr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ, bʌt aɪ ˈdɪdənt fərˈɡɛt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈwɜːrd.

passage.text: After my speech, a student from Brazil came over and said that he agreed with me.
passage.reading: ˈæftər maɪ ˈspiːtʃ, ə ˈstuːdənt frəm brəˈzɪl ˈkeɪm ˈoʊvər ənd ˈsɛd ðæt hiː əˈɡriːd wɪð miː.

passage.text: We decided to write a proposal together.
passage.reading: wiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈraɪt ə prəˈpoʊzəl təˈɡɛðər.

passage.text: We worked on our proposal until late last night.
passage.reading: wiː ˈwɜːrkt ɑːn aʊr prəˈpoʊzəl ənˈtɪl ˈleɪt ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: Today, all the representatives voted, and our proposal passed!
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ, ˈɔːl ðə ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntətɪvz ˈvoʊtɪd, ənd aʊr prəˈpoʊzəl ˈpæst!

passage.text: I learned so much this weekend: how to speak in public, how to listen and how to find solutions with people who think differently.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈlɜːrnd soʊ ˈmʌtʃ ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd: ˈhaʊ tə ˈspiːk ɪn ˈpʌblɪk, ˈhaʊ tə ˈlɪsən ənd ˈhaʊ tə ˈfaɪnd səˈluːʃənz wɪð ˈpiːpəl huː ˈθɪŋk ˈdɪfərəntli.

passage.text: I'm definitely going to join the next conference.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈdɛfənətli ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈdʒɔɪn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈkɑːnfərəns.
